spans.s: yātrā (EI 11; CII 4), festival; the festival of a deity; same as yātr-otsava.

yātrā-dāna (EI 27), gift or levy for running a festival.
 (SITI), propitiatory gift made before starting on an expedition of conquest by the king.
yātr-otsava (IE 8-5; EI 3, 9), same as yātrā (q. v.); the festival of a deity; festival in honour of a deity.
